_comment: THE authoritative category list. Edit here and nowhere else.
server/internal/workspace/categories.json is a synced copy (the two build
contexts are ./client and ./server, so neither can import the other's file).
After editing, run `task categories:sync`; the drift test fails if they differ.
hosted=false means desktop-only: the workspace-service never seeds it, so it
cannot appear on the web build. A vault is a folder of real files on disk, so
it has no meaning without a local filesystem.
`icon` is currently unread — CategoryIcon resolves icons by slug. It is kept
for the API contract (the categories table column) and because a future
consumer would expect it. That it went unread is exactly why it drifted.

categories.name: Board
categories.description: A freeform canvas of beat cards, lanes and connections.
